result.stdout:
context-sync - deliver artifacts to, and materialise knowledge from, a ContextHub workspace

usage:
  context-sync init     --url <base> --workspace <id> --layer <layer> [--platform github|azuredevops|gitlab] [--out <dir>]
  context-sync context  --out <dir> [--include-chunks] [--require <kind>[=<min>]]...
  context-sync validate --root <dir> [--layer <layer>] [--source-commit <sha>]
  context-sync publish  --root <dir> [--layer <layer>] [--activate] [--source-commit <sha>]
  context-sync gap      (--file <gaps.json> | --need <text> [--why <text>] [--considered a,b] | --list) [--strict]

common options (env fallback in parentheses):
  --url <base>        the API base URL              (CONTEXTHUB_URL)
  --workspace <id>    the workspace to act in       (CONTEXTHUB_WORKSPACE)
  --config <path>     config file                   (default: <root>/context-sync.json)
  credential          CONTEXTHUB_TOKEN only - never a flag, never a config key
url, workspace and layer may come from context-sync.json; flags and environment override it.

init      scaffold a customer workflow repository: workflows/skills/ontologies folders,
          context-sync.json, README, an agent orientation file, and the pipeline for
          --platform. Refuses to overwrite existing files.
context   materialise the workspace's knowledge into agent-readable files:
          INDEX.md + one page per node grouped by kind, plus brain.json (the raw export).
          Fails without writing when the context would be empty or a --require is unmet.
validate  dry-run the artifact set under --root ({workflows,skills,ontologies}/*.json)
          against the server; non-zero exit with every per-file verdict. No rule runs
          locally - validation lives where the rules are.
publish   deliver the same set for real. Versions are minted, nothing is activated
          unless --activate (and a brand-new artifact, which has nothing live to change).
gap       register "this needs a step that does not exist" as a structured capability gap
          ({ need, why
[truncated]
